subject: Pre-show warmup: sponsor demo access, camera cues, and fallback plan
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@brightfin.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick Q: keynote demo constraints and camera/cue options

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for coordinating BrightFin's sponsored demo slot on the 21st. Two quick questions so we can finalize the asset pack: 

1) Demo format: would you prefer we do a live browser demo (with a temporary account) or upload a short pre-recorded clip? Our marketing lead wants to know the maximum contiguous live demo time you can tolerate (we were thinking 3 minutes).

2) Camera / presenter cues: do you have a preferred camera framing and cue language for the host to hand off to our presenter? We can supply a teleprompter cue and an on-camera intro if that helps.

If it matters, the demo will show a live journey through an onboarding flow and an alert triage — nothing requiring client data.

Appreciate the quick guidance so we can finalize the file formats.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Partnerships, BrightFin
[BrightFin Events <events@brightfin.com>]

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: samantha@brightfin.com
Date: 2027-04-16T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick Q: keynote demo constraints and camera/cue options

Karthik / Marissa — looping you in to lock the execution plan. Samantha: forwarding to our ops folks so we can land this quickly. Notes and asks below.

Summary: we can support either live browser demo or a pre-recorded clip as a fallback. Live demo constraints: ~3 minutes live is fine if we provision an ephemeral account and capture a short smoke test during rehearsal. Fallback: pre-recorded 2:30–3:15 clip (MP4 H.264) is acceptable.

Karthik: can you provision a time-limited sandbox account and a simple recording checklist? If live, we will run a quick network check for the presenter during the tech rehearsal. Please include steps to disable any telemetry/PHI.

Marissa: can you take ownership of the fallback recording and provide a 30s highlight clip (for host intro) + full clip? Also draft a 3-line host handoff and camera framing guidance (close-up vs medium shot).

Attachments: sponsor_demo_spec.md (required fields for the clip), live-demo-checklist.pdf (what ops will run during rehearsal).

Timeline: Tech rehearsal slot proposal: Wed Apr 21 10:00 PT (30 minutes). Please confirm availability.

Thanks — will circle back once we have confirmations.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: samantha@brightfin.com
Date: 2027-04-16T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick Q: keynote demo constraints and camera/cue options

Lauren / team — I can do the sandbox provisioning. Planned steps:
- Create ephemeral 'brightfin_demo' account (expires 24h after rehearsal)
- Populate with generic test data and disable outgoing webhooks
- Record a 30s smoke test (screen capture) and share the file before the rehearsal

Question for Samantha: which exact pages should we prioritize? Home onboarding flow vs. alert triage? If you can flag 3 canonical URLs/screens we will script the clicks.

Attachment: redwood_demo_sandbox_installer.sh (script to prep environment).

I’ll queue this up and post the sandbox credentials in last-mile secure notes on the rehearsal day.

— Karthik

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: samantha@brightfin.com
Date: 2027-04-16T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick Q: keynote demo constraints and camera/cue options

Thanks — confirmed. I’ll produce:
- One 30s highlight (host intro) + one 2:45 full clip (MP4) as fallback
- Host handoff script (three lines) and two camera framing options: medium (waist-up) for live handoff, close-up for the presenter during the demo.

Proposed rehearsal agenda (30m):
1) 5m intro + confirm roles (host, presenter, AV)
2) 10m live demo walkthrough (or playback of full clip)
3) 10m run host handoff + cue practice + AV check
4) 5m contingency + Qs

I have a tentative tech rehearsal window Wed Apr 21 10:00–10:30 PT — Samantha / BrightFin, please confirm.

Attachments: brightfin_demo_v2.mp4 (prelim fallback clip), run_of_show_excerpt.txt (host handoff + timestamps).

— Marissa

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@brightfin.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, events@brightfin.com
Date: 2027-04-18T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed: tech rehearsal Wed Apr 21 10:00 PT + demo fallback plan

Samantha — we’re confirmed for Wed Apr 21 at 10:00 PT (Zoom link below). AV will join 15 minutes early for a line check.

What to expect:
- Rehearsal length: 30 minutes. Please have your presenter and one technical contact available.
- Live vs fallback: we’ll attempt a short live demo (max 3 minutes) using the ephemeral account Karthik will provision. If network or auth issues arise, we will pivot to the supplied MP4 (Marissa’s brightfin_demo_v2.mp4).
- Host handoff: three-line script attached in the run_of_show_excerpt.txt; host will use "medium" framing for the handoff and cut to presenter close-up for the demo.

Deliverables we need from BrightFin by Mon Apr 19 17:00 PT:
- Preferred three pages/URLs for the demo (or "canonical flows")
- Presenter headshot and pronouns for on-screen lower-third (png)
- Final MP4 (if you prefer fallback) or confirmation to go live

Attachments included on thread: sponsor_demo_spec.md, live-demo-checklist.pdf, redwood_demo_sandbox_installer.sh, brightfin_demo_v2.mp4, run_of_show_excerpt.txt

Links:
Zoom (rehearsal): https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=example
Shared assets: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B_example_drive_link
Sponsor agreement (signed): https://www.docusign.com/brightfin-sponsor-agreement/ABC123

Samantha — please reply with the three pages and presenter availability. We’ll also add a short follow-up invite with the rehearsal calendar entry.

— Lauren
Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
